run_conformance_test: run a protobuf conformance test by parsing a request and serializing the response to stdout
test_do_test_function: test the do_test function with a protobuf payload and verify JSON output serialization
create_test_message: create a protobuf test message instance for proto2, proto3, or edition2023 types
review_protocol_error_class: review the ProtocolError exception class used for handling invalid conformance requests
refactor_do_test_io: refactor the do_test_io function to support a different input output protocol
